verification_note: County report printed 07/07/10 and headed Official Results for the June 8, 2010 gubernatorial primary lists Cheryl Cox 18,771 (53.55 percent), Steve Castaneda 9,886 (28.21 percent) and Jorge Dominguez 4,561 (13.01 percent). The Total Votes column shows 33,333. The three candidate totals sum to 33,218; the report does not itemize the other 115 votes (write-ins or similar), and total_votes uses the report's Total Votes column. Cox holds a majority of the votes cast. Chula Vista Charter section 300(E) (Internet Archive capture of 2019-11-15) says the Mayor is deemed elected on receipt of a majority at the general municipal election, which section 900 holds on the state primary date, and a runoff applies only if no majority. The same section says the top-two mayoral election manner begins in 2014. No Chula Vista mayoral contest appears in the county November 2, 2010 results.
total_votes_basis: County report Total Votes column for the Chula Vista mayor contest, citywide (San Diego County portion); includes 115 votes not itemized by candidate
